dedupe_keys.name: assessment of stormwater infrastructure for mitigating flooding and non point source pollution

description: Assessment of Stormwater Infrastructure for Mitigating Flooding and Non-point Source Pollution is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Zhang, Yu (deposited on HydroShare). In recent years, severe storms and catastrophic flooding along the Gulf Coast has causes water quality issues in bays and estuaries and contributes to hypoxia in the Gulf of Mexico through increased nutrient and sediment loads and suppression of oxygen exchange. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2021-11-30 and last updated 2021-11-30; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
